name: unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const T) -> Self
rule: For safety, `ptr` must point to a block of memory allocated by the global allocator, except for the explicitly supported pointers originating from `Weak::new` and converted by `Weak::into_raw`.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > alloc::rc::Weak < T > { unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const T) -> Self }
